modules.text:
Syntona has modules that can be connected together. Modules have input and output jacks where connections are made.

This patch has a "fader" and "show "module. Click in the middle of the knob and move the mouse up and down. The knob sends messages with a number to the show module which displays the number.

There is also a fader and a show module that are not connected. You can connect them. Click on the output jack of the knob and drag a line over to the input jack of the show module and then release the mouse. Keep trying until you are able to connect them.

When you are done, click the ">> Next" link at the top right to move to the next page.
